home.title: SmartAgents · Digital colleagues that never sleep
home.description: SmartAgents builds digital colleagues for Belgian organisations: process optimisation, agentic automation, training and coaching, and AI staffing.
service.process.title: Process optimisation
service.process.menu: Getting your operation clear before a single line of code is written.
service.process.body: AI opens up new possibilities inside your processes and improves the steps you already have. We help you spot those opportunities and actually implement them.
service.agentic.title: Agentic automation
service.agentic.menu: Agents that plan, read and finish multi-step work, with logs.
service.agentic.body: Building agents into new or existing processes, so your software is built for what comes next.
service.training.title: Training and coaching
service.training.menu: Workshops built on projects, exercises and supporting slides.
service.training.body: Workshops built on projects, exercises and supporting slides. For the teams who work with AI and the developers who build with it.
service.staffing.title: AI staffing
service.staffing.menu: Profiles screened on what they have actually built.
service.staffing.body: On paper everyone is an AI expert. We screen profiles the way we would want to be screened ourselves: on what they have built.
dna.1.title: Hands-on people
dna.1.body: We use AI tooling every day ourselves. What we recommend to you runs at our place first.
dna.2.title: Software engineers
dna.2.body: We have broad experience with enterprise systems, from analysis to build.
dna.3.title: Innovators
dna.3.body: New technology draws us in, and gives us energy.
dna.4.title: Partners
dna.4.body: We look for like-minded companies that want to grow, and we stay until that actually happens.

step.1.title: SmartScan
step.1.body: We map your processes and bottlenecks, and say honestly where AI adds nothing.
step.2.title: Design
step.2.body: We draw out the new workflow and pick where agents and integrations pay off most.
step.3.title: Development
step.3.body: We build in short rounds. You test along on real files and steer while it takes shape.
step.4.title: Implementation
step.4.body: Rolling out in your environment, connecting to your systems, and bringing along the people who have to work with it.
step.5.title: Optimisation
step.5.body: We keep measuring and adjusting. Whatever goes unused, we take back out.
smartspace.title: One workspace where your agents and your people sit side by side.
smartspace.body: Mail, invoices, quotes, tenders, calculations: modules you switch on when you need them. You talk to SmartSpace, the work happens in view, and you can read back every step.

training.title: Training and coaching · SmartAgents
training.description: Workshops built on projects, exercises and supporting slides. From a first introduction to AI to developers who build with it every day.
training.hero.title: Learn to use AI like a professional
training.why.title: Why invest in AI training?
training.why.body: Using AI professionally is a craft: the right technique for the right task, and a clear view of what every question costs. Your people learn it from trainers who build with it every day, and who simply pass their tricks on.
training.offer.title: Our courses
training.course.business.title: AI for business teams
training.course.business.tools: An AI subscription, your own laptop
training.course.business.body: You learn to put AI on the work that comes back every week: not one clever prompt, but a way of working you repeat and hand on.
training.course.business.learn.1: Asking questions that return the same result every time
training.course.business.learn.2: Turning recurring work into a workflow
training.course.business.learn.3: Building simple assistants, without a line of code
training.course.business.learn.4: Handling company data and sensitive work safely
training.course.agentic.title: Agentic engineering
training.course.agentic.tools: An AI subscription, an IDE, your own laptop
training.course.agentic.body: Teach AI engineers to use AI cost-consciously and efficiently, to generate code and optimise processes.
training.course.agentic.learn.1: Putting agents on a ticket, a bug, a refactor
training.course.agentic.learn.2: Design patterns for the work you hand over
training.course.agentic.learn.3: What every question costs, and how to keep it down
training.course.agentic.learn.4: Guarding code quality with review, tests and guardrails
training.format.title: How a course runs
training.format.body: Not a presentation you sit through. Explanation, exercises and labs alternate, with room for your own questions and a trainer looking over your shoulder.
training.format.tags: Course material · Exercises · Labs · Q&A · Slides · Mentoring
training.format.accents: The emphasis is on what you use the day after: smarter use of AI, a clear view of what every question costs, and workflows that fit the way your team already works. The slides and the course material stay yours afterwards.
training.format.videoLabel: Tour of the SmartAgents developer course
training.benefit.adoption.title: Faster adoption
training.benefit.adoption.body: Teams that understand what AI does pick up new tools faster and find their own use cases.
training.benefit.productivity.title: Higher productivity
training.benefit.productivity.body: People who really use AI tools in their daily work, not only during a demo.
training.benefit.risk.title: Less risk
training.benefit.risk.body: Anyone who knows the limits of AI makes better decisions and avoids expensive mistakes.
training.benefit.return.title: Lasting return
training.benefit.return.body: Training that sticks, because the exercises come from your own practice.
training.benefit.autonomy.title: Less dependent on outside help
training.benefit.autonomy.body: People who apply AI themselves need less help with routine work and small adjustments.
training.cta.title: Ready to upskill your team?
training.cta.body: Tell us briefly who needs training and on what. We propose a programme to measure, at your office or remote, and we also say when a training is not needed.
